subject: exclude groups with only NA, keep those with some NA

messages.author: bbf6170126968d7a
messages.subject: exclude groups with only NA, keep those with some NA
parts:
Hello everyone,

I've solved this problem but am wondering if there was a more direct answer that I've missed.

I'd like to filter a data.frame to remove all the groups where a numeric column is NA, but keep groups where at least one value is not NA.

Here is an example (gets the right answer) :

```
na_lvls <- data_frame(x = c("a","a","a","b","b","b"),
                      y = c(NA, NA, NA, 3, NA, 2))

na_lvls %>%
  group_by(x) %>%
  summarize(all_na = all(is.na(y))) %>%
  filter(!all_na) %>%
  semi_join(na_lvls, .)

## returns
# Source: local data frame [3 x 2]

#   x  y
#1 b  3
#2 b NA
#3 b  2
```



I guess I thought that it should be possible to do this directly via `filter`, but it seems like not?

Thanks for your wisdom!
Andrew
